<script>
// Game logic and progression implementation
// This script adds real gameplay systems, state transitions, and interactive elements

// Initialize game state
let gameState = {
  player: {
    health: 100,
    inventory: [],
    position: { x: 0, y: 0 }
  },
  map: {
    width: 20,
    height: 20,
    tiles: Array(20).fill().map(() => Array(20).fill(0))
  },
  items: []
};

// Add player interaction
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  const rect = e.target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = rect.x + e.clientX - window.innerWidth / 2;
  const y = rect.y + e.clientY - window.innerHeight / 2;

  // Check if click is within game area
  if (x > 0 && x < 20 && y > 0 && y < 20) {
    const tile = gameState.map.tiles[Math.floor(x / 20) * 20 + Math.floor(y / 20)];
    if (tile === 1) {
      // Player encounters a trap
      gameState.player.health -= 20;
      alert("You stepped on a trap! You're hurt.");
    } else if (tile === 3) {
      // Player finds an item
      gameState.items.push(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'key' : 'potion');
      alert("You found an item!");
    }
  }
});

// Update game state
function updateGameState() {
  // Simple state transition: player moves right
  gameState.player.position.x += 1;
  if (gameState.player.position.x >= gameState.map.width) {
    gameState.player.position.x = 0;
  }
}

// Game loop
setInterval(updateGameState, 1000);

// Check for win condition
function checkWinCondition() {
  if (gameState.player.health <= 0) {
    alert("You lost!");
    resetGame();
  }
}

// Reset game
function resetGame() {
  gameState.player.health = 100;
  gameState.player.inventory = [];
  gameState.player.position = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  gameState.map.tiles = Array(20).fill().map(() => Array(20).fill(0));
  gameState.items = [];
  alert("Game reset. Start fresh!");
}

// Trigger win condition
setInterval(checkWinCondition, 5000);
</script>
